left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient of the UNC Center for Excellence for Eating Disorders inpatient unit  [OR] or outpatient clinic

right.raw_text:
-  Diagnosis of anorexia nervosa  [OR] or bulimia nervosa
  -  Aged 13-50 years
  -  English-speaking
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Decisionally impaired (i

, Incapable of providing informed consent in the opinion of the primary care provider in UNC Center for Excellence for Eating Disorders)
  -  Involuntarily committed to the inpatient service of the UNC Department of Psychiatry
